title: The Shrine Maiden's Riddle
setup_text: A shrine maiden blocks your path. She speaks:
setup_text_target: 道を塞ぐ巫女が、静かに問いかける。
npc_dialogue: 「あなたは何を求めているのですか？」

options.outcome_text: The maiden smiles and steps aside, placing a glowing scroll in your hands.
options.outcome_text_target: 巫女は微笑み、道を開ける。あなたの手には淡く光る巻物が残された。

reward.description: A random card in your deck is upgraded.
reward.description_target: 牌组中的一张随机卡牌获得升级。

options.outcome_text: The maiden nods solemnly. 'Power alone will not carry you to the summit.'
options.outcome_text_target: 巫女郑重地点头：“仅靠力量，无法抵达山巅。”

title: The Wandering Monk
setup_text: An old monk sits by the road, studying a worn scroll. He looks up and asks:
setup_text_target: 路边坐着一位老僧，正翻看破旧卷轴。他抬头问你：
npc_dialogue: 「この言葉の意味がわかりますか？」
npc_dialogue_translation: Do you understand the meaning of these words?

options.outcome_text: The monk beams. 'A rare traveler!' He shares his provisions.
options.outcome_text_target: 僧人露出笑容：“少见的旅人！”他分给你一些补给。

options.outcome_text: The monk chuckles. 'Honesty is its own wisdom. But the mountain does not forgive ignorance.' A cold wind saps your strength.
options.outcome_text_target: 僧人轻笑：“诚实也是智慧，但山不会宽恕无知。”寒风掠过，你感到虚弱。

title: The Spirit Fork
setup_text: The path splits. A small fox spirit sits at the crossroads, cleaning its paws. It looks up:
setup_text_target: 道路在前方分岔。路口坐着一只小狐灵，正舔着爪子，抬头看向你：
npc_dialogue: 「右か左か、どちらに行きますか？右は「危険」、左は「安全」と書いてあります。」
npc_dialogue_translation: Right or left — which will you go? The right sign reads 'Danger', the left reads 'Safety'.

options.outcome_text: The dangerous path is littered with abandoned relics. You pocket a glowing item.
options.outcome_text_target: 危险小路上散落着被遗弃的遗物。你捡起了一件发光的宝物。

options.outcome_text: The safe path is peaceful. You arrive rested.
options.outcome_text_target: 安全的小路宁静安稳。你以更好的状态继续前进。

title: The Rate-Limited Sage
setup_text: A hunched scribe sits beside a stone lantern, staring at blank slips. They whisper about "spirit-tokens" running dry and every thought arriving one word per second.
setup_text_target: 一名驼背书吏坐在石灯笼旁，对着空白木简发呆。他小声抱怨「灵牌」用尽，念头像被节流，一个字一个字往外蹦。
npc_dialogue: 「今日の配分は尽きた…残りは手で書くしかない。」
npc_dialogue_translation: Today's allotment is gone… from here I can only write by hand.

options.translation: I get it. Let's take a break.
options.outcome_text: You share rations and bad jokes about compile times. The sage breathes easier — empathy restores more than caffeine.
options.outcome_text_target: 你分了干粮，又吐槽了两句编译速度。书吏长舒一口气：共情比咖啡因更回血。

options.translation: I'll pay. Hurry up and keep going.
options.outcome_text: You toss coins. The scribe blinks. 'Gold doesn't refill the well — but thanks for the tip.' They scribble a lucky charm on your sleeve.
options.outcome_text_target: 你扔下金币。书吏眨眼：「钱填不满井，但谢了。」他在你袖上画了道潦草的幸运符。

reward.description: You receive 8 gold (found tucked in the charm).
reward.description_target: 从符咒夹层里摸到 8 枚金币。

options.outcome_text: The sage's eye twitches. A curse of envy settles on you — suddenly every step feels like waiting on a spinner.
options.outcome_text_target: 书吏眼角抽搐。妒火化作轻咒：你每走一步都像在等加载转圈。
